_comment: Registered commands that production frontend code never reaches. Each entry is either scheduled for removal or kept on purpose (see plans/simplify.md). check-ipc.mjs flags unreferenced commands missing from this list and entries that are no longer registered.

commands.set_meeting_detection_enabled: no UI yet; wired to a setting in 0.1.28
commands.is_meeting_detection_enabled: no UI yet; wired to a setting in 0.1.28
